title: 柱色谱分离
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/10_Column Chromatography.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/10_Column Chromatography/src.py

points.K1: 柱色谱：最常用的纯化方法
points.K10: 吸附剂在通风柜内取用
points.S2: 台面溶剂少放、远离火源

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一根装满白色粉末的玻璃柱旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a tall glass column filled with white powder clamped on a ring stand, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学柱色谱，把混合物分开。

shots.scene: 选条件、装柱、上样、跑柱四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a small plate with spots, a column being filled, a dropper over the column, and a rack of test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 选条件、装柱、上样、跑柱，一步步来。

shots.scene: 阿杰手里拿着一瓶黄色油状混合物发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small flask of yellow oily mixture and looks worried.
shots.narration: 阿杰的产物里混着好几种东西。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手把粉末往柱子里倒，小研摆手阻止
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts dumping dry powder into an empty column; the female graduate student raises her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想抓一把硅胶装柱就跑。

shots.scene: 小研戴着护目镜，指向通风柜和桌上的TLC板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles, points at a fume hood and at small blank plates on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：先摸条件，再进通风柜装柱。

shots.section_title: 柱色谱：最常用的纯化方法
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一排试管，每支颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a row of test tubes with liquids of slightly different colors.
shots.narration: 柱色谱是有机实验室最常用的纯化法。
overlay: 柱色谱：最常用的纯化方法

shots.section_title: 柱色谱：最常用的纯化方法
shots.scene: 极性不同的小球在柱中跑得快慢不同
shots.prompt_en: Icons of round beads of two colors moving down a column at different speeds. No people.
shots.narration: 它靠化合物极性不同，把混合物分开。

shots.section_title: 柱色谱：最常用的纯化方法
shots.scene: 天平上的一小瓶样品，旁边勾号
shots.prompt_en: A small sample vial on a balance with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 常用来分离克级样品，多练就熟。

shots.scene: 玻璃柱结构示意：底部活塞，里面白色吸附剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a glass column with a stopcock at the bottom and a white adsorbent bed inside. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃柱底部有活塞，里面装硅胶或氧化铝。

shots.scene: 样品色带加在柱顶，溶剂流下
shots.prompt_en: A colored sample band sits on top of the adsorbent bed while solvent flows down through it. No people.
shots.narration: 样品加在顶部，让溶剂往下流。

shots.scene: 色带从柱底流出进入试管
shots.prompt_en: The colored band reaches the bottom and drips out into a test tube. No people.
shots.narration: 化合物被一个个冲出柱底。

shots.scene: 加压接头压在柱顶，箭头向下
shots.prompt_en: A pressure adapter with a hose presses on top of the column; arrows point downward. No people.
shots.narration: 多数时候用快速柱：柱顶加压。

shots.scene: 秒表图标和两条分开的色带
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon next to two cleanly separated colored bands in a column. No people.
shots.narration: 跑得更快，分得也更好。

shots.scene: 小研看着两瓶溶剂，一瓶标极性图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at two solvent bottles with blank labels, one marked with a polar icon.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂体系，是成败关键。

shots.scene: 极性与非极性两瓶溶剂混合成一瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two solvent bottles, one polar and one nonpolar, pour into a single mixing cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 一般是一极性一非极性，两种互溶溶剂。

shots.scene: TLC小板上的斑点
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small blank thin layer plate with two spots on it. No people.
shots.narration: 用TLC薄层色谱来找最佳比例。

shots.scene: 滴管往小瓶里加约一毫升溶剂溶样
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a dropper to add a little solvent to a small vial of sample.
shots.narration: 少量样品溶在一毫升左右溶剂里。

shots.scene: 毛细管在几块小板上点样
shots.prompt_en: A capillary spots the same sample on several small plates. No people.
shots.narration: 点几块板，各用不同体系展开。

shots.scene: TLC板与柱子里的白色吸附剂用等号连接
shots.prompt_en: A small plate and a column of white adsorbent linked by an equals sign icon. No people.
shots.narration: 板上的吸附剂要和柱子一致。

shots.scene: 展开缸，两瓶溶剂图标
shots.prompt_en: A glass developing jar with a plate inside, next to two solvent bottles with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 最常用的是乙酸乙酯配正己烷。

shots.scene: 易挥发的小瓶冒出蒸气，旁边低沸点溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A small vial with vapor lines rising from it, next to two bottles marked with a low thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样品易挥发，用乙醚戊烷等低沸点体系。

shots.scene: 强极性样品图标，旁边两瓶溶剂
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a strongly polar molecule next to two bottles with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 强极性的，常用甲醇配二氯甲烷。

shots.scene: TLC板上一个大斑点和一个小斑点
shots.prompt_en: A plate with one large spot and one faint small spot. No people.
shots.narration: 去除少量杂质时，盯住主成分。

shots.scene: 斑点位于板高约三成处，刻度标出
shots.prompt_en: The large spot sits about a third of the way up the plate, with a scale bar beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 调极性，让主成分Rf在0.3左右。

shots.scene: 斑点贴近底线，乌龟图标
shots.prompt_en: A spot barely above the starting line, next to a slow turtle icon. No people.
shots.narration: Rf太低，体系太非极性，出柱太慢。

shots.scene: 斑点接近顶端，两点挤在一起
shots.prompt_en: Two spots crowded near the top of the plate, next to a rushing arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: Rf太高，体系太极性，跑太快分不开。

shots.scene: 两个斑点中点位于0.3处
shots.prompt_en: Two spots on a plate with their midpoint marked at about a third of the height. No people.
shots.narration: 分离两种以上，让两点中点在0.3。

shots.scene: 极性相差很大的两个斑点
shots.prompt_en: A plate with one spot near the top and another near the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 极性相差大，可以用梯度洗脱。

shots.scene: 先用低极性溶剂，第一个色带出柱
shots.prompt_en: A column where the first band leaves the bottom while a low polarity solvent bottle feeds the top. No people.
shots.narration: 先让最不极性的组分Rf约0.3。

shots.scene: 极性指针逐步升高，第二个色带下移
shots.prompt_en: A polarity gauge needle rises step by step while the second band moves down the column. No people.
shots.narration: 出完再慢慢提极性，冲下一个。

shots.section_title: 吸附剂在通风柜内取用
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一袋白色粉末，旁边警示图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a bag of white powder with a caution icon beside it.
shots.narration: 本片用硅胶，氧化铝做法相同。
overlay: 吸附剂在通风柜内取用

shots.section_title: 吸附剂在通风柜内取用
shots.scene: 硅胶粉尘飘向人脸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fine powder dust drifting toward a face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 硅胶、氧化铝粉尘吸入有害。

shots.section_title: 吸附剂在通风柜内取用
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内取硅胶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scoops white powder inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 吸附剂一律在通风柜里取用。

shots.scene: 天平两边：一份化合物对二十份硅胶
shots.prompt_en: A balance diagram: one small weight of compound on one side, twenty small blocks of white powder on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 分离好时，硅胶约为样品的二十倍。

shots.scene: 难分时硅胶堆更高
shots.prompt_en: Two heaps of white powder growing taller beside a hard-to-separate pair of spots. No people.
shots.narration: 难分离时，要五十到一百倍。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man for advice beside the column setup.
shots.narration: 尽量少用，拿不准就问有经验的人。

shots.scene: 通风柜里把硅胶称进大锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, white powder is weighed into a large Erlenmeyer flask on a balance. No people.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里，把硅胶称进锥形瓶。

shots.scene: 瓶内硅胶只到三分之一高度
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the flask filled with powder only to one third of its height, with a line marker. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶子要大，装量不超过三分之一。

shots.scene: 粗细不同的三根柱子并排
shots.prompt_en: Three empty glass columns of different widths stand side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 柱径怎么选？看硅胶能装多高。

shots.scene: 硅胶层高度用尺标出约十五到十八厘米
shots.prompt_en: A column with the white bed height marked by a ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一般让硅胶装到十五到十八厘米。

shots.scene: 太高的柱子色带拉长重叠，太矮的色带挤在一起
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: in the tall one the bands smear and overlap, in the short one the bands crowd together. No people.
shots.narration: 太高谱带会散开，太矮分离面积不够。

shots.scene: 手指搓一小团棉花，投进空柱
shots.prompt_en: Gloved fingers roll a small piece of cotton and drop it into the empty column.
shots.narration: 柱底先塞一小团棉花，挡住硅胶。

shots.scene: 倾斜轻敲柱子，棉花落进底部中心
shots.prompt_en: The column is tilted and tapped gently so the cotton settles into the center at the bottom.
shots.narration: 倾斜轻敲，让棉花落到中心。

shots.scene: 长棒轻压棉花，塞得太紧的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A long rod gently presses the cotton; a separate icon of tightly jammed cotton is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 用长棒轻压，别塞太紧。

shots.scene: 台面上摆着烧杯、滴管、漏斗、溶剂、硅胶、沙子、加压接头
shots.prompt_en: On a bench inside a fume hood: an empty beaker, a dropper, a funnel, a solvent bottle, a flask of white powder, a jar of sand and a pressure adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 备好烧杯、滴管、漏斗、溶剂、硅胶和沙。

shots.scene: 柱子垂直夹牢，漏斗加一薄层沙
shots.prompt_en: The column is clamped straight up and a thin layer of sand is poured in through a funnel.
shots.narration: 柱子竖直夹牢，加一薄层沙。

shots.scene: 加入溶剂，沙层平整，柱壁干净
shots.prompt_en: Solvent is poured into the column; the sand layer is flat and the walls are clean. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一段溶剂，沙面要平，壁上不沾沙。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶里硅胶加溶剂调成稀匀浆
shots.prompt_en: Solvent is poured into the flask of white powder and swirled into a runny slurry. No people.
shots.narration: 硅胶加溶剂，调成能流动的匀浆。

shots.scene: 匀浆经漏斗倒进柱子
shots.prompt_en: The white slurry is poured through a funnel into the column without disturbing the sand.
shots.narration: 摇匀后小心倒入，别冲乱沙层。

shots.scene: 用溶剂冲洗漏斗和柱壁
shots.prompt_en: A dropper rinses the funnel and the column walls with solvent.
shots.narration: 余下的硅胶用溶剂转移，冲净漏斗和柱壁。

shots.scene: 加压接头压在柱顶，活塞打开
shots.prompt_en: A pressure adapter is pressed on top and the stopcock is opened; solvent drips out into a beaker.
shots.narration: 柱顶加压，打开活塞。

shots.scene: 手指轻敲柱壁，硅胶面变平
shots.prompt_en: Fingers tap the side of the column gently and the top of the white bed becomes flat.
shots.narration: 轻敲柱壁，让硅胶面平整。

shots.scene: 液面降到硅胶上方一段，关活塞撤压
shots.prompt_en: The liquid level drops to a few centimeters above the bed, then the stopcock is closed and the adapter removed.
shots.narration: 放到硅胶上方五到八厘米，关阀撤压。

shots.scene: 硅胶层里的气泡被红圈圈出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the white bed with small air bubbles circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 加沙前检查：不能有气泡。

shots.scene: 有气泡的柱子色带歪斜
shots.prompt_en: A column with bubbles where the colored band runs crooked and uneven. No people.
shots.narration: 气泡和不均匀，后面会出大问题。

shots.scene: 稀匀浆、轻敲、先加压三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a very runny slurry, a tapping finger, and a pressure arrow before an open valve. No people.
shots.narration: 匀浆调稀、边装边敲、先加压再开阀。

shots.scene: 滴管冲下柱壁上的硅胶
shots.prompt_en: A dropper washes stray white powder from the column walls down onto the bed.
shots.narration: 硅胶面均匀后，冲下壁上的硅胶。

shots.scene: 漏斗轻轻加一薄层沙
shots.prompt_en: A thin layer of sand is added gently through a funnel onto the bed.
shots.narration: 小心加一薄层沙，别扰动硅胶面。

shots.scene: 加压放液到刚高于硅胶面
shots.prompt_en: With pressure on, the liquid level is drained to just above the bed. No people.
shots.narration: 冲下壁上的沙，放液到硅胶面上方。

shots.scene: 液面低于硅胶、硅胶开裂发白的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the liquid level dropping below the bed top with cracks in the white bed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液面绝不能降到硅胶顶面以下！

shots.scene: 欣欣指着液面线强调
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the liquid line above the bed in a column diagram.
shots.narration: 跑干了柱子会开裂，前功尽弃。

shots.scene: 样品在少量溶剂中溶解
shots.prompt_en: A sample dissolves in a very small amount of solvent in a little beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 样品溶得动，就用溶液上样。

shots.scene: 滴管加几滴另一种溶剂帮助溶解
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds a few drops of another solvent to help the sample dissolve. No people.
shots.narration: 体积越少越好，难溶加几滴二氯甲烷。

shots.scene: 完全澄清的溶液，勾号
shots.prompt_en: A completely clear solution with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要完全溶解，再上柱。

shots.scene: 滴管沿柱壁一圈慢慢滴加样品液
shots.prompt_en: A dropper slowly drips the sample solution around the inner wall of the column.
shots.narration: 沿柱壁一圈慢慢滴，别冲乱沙层。

shots.scene: 少量溶剂荡洗样品瓶并加入柱中
shots.prompt_en: A little solvent rinses the sample beaker and is added to the column the same way.
shots.narration: 放低液面，用少量溶剂荡洗原瓶加入。

shots.scene: 重复荡洗，冲下柱壁残样
shots.prompt_en: The rinse is repeated and the column walls are washed down, lowering the level between rinses. No people.
shots.narration: 重复一两次，壁上残样也冲下。

shots.scene: 滴管先加一层溶剂作缓冲
shots.prompt_en: A dropper gently adds a cushion of solvent on top of the sand. No people.
shots.narration: 先用滴管加一层溶剂作缓冲。

shots.scene: 缓慢倒满溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Solvent is poured slowly into the column without disturbing the bed.
shots.narration: 再慢慢倒满，不冲动沙和硅胶。

shots.scene: 沙层下方一条窄窄的色带
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a thin narrow colored band just below the sand layer. No people.
shots.narration: 做得好，沙层下是一条窄谱带。

shots.scene: 样品在溶剂里溶不动
shots.prompt_en: A sample sits undissolved in a flask of solvent with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 样品在体系里溶不动？用干法上样。

shots.scene: 样品溶于二氯甲烷转入圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The sample solution is transferred with a dropper into a round-bottom flask inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 先溶在二氯甲烷里，转入圆底烧瓶。

shots.scene: 加入少量硅胶摇匀
shots.prompt_en: A small amount of white powder is added to the round-bottom flask and swirled. No people.
shots.narration: 荡洗几次，加少量硅胶摇匀。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸塞进防暴沸球
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands stuff a few plain lab tissues into a glass bump trap.
shots.narration: 旋蒸前，防暴沸球里塞几张擦拭纸。

shots.scene: 旋转蒸发仪上烧瓶在转动
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask spins on a rotary evaporator over a warm bath. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住细粉，不污染旋转蒸发仪。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里是松散能流动的黄色粉末
shots.prompt_en: A flask with loose, free-flowing yellow powder tilted to show it flows. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸到细腻、能自由流动的粉末。

shots.scene: 结块发黏的粉末被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sticky clumped powder in a flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 结块发黏，重溶多加硅胶，别急着上柱。

shots.scene: 沙层上方留一薄层溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A packed column with a thin layer of solvent left above the sand. No people.
shots.narration: 照常装柱，沙上留一薄层溶剂。

shots.scene: 把黄色粉末倒在沙层上
shots.prompt_en: The yellow powder is poured from the flask onto the sand through a funnel.
shots.narration: 把预吸附的硅胶倒在沙层上。

shots.scene: 冲下壁上粉末，加沙，加满溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The walls are rinsed, a thin layer of sand is added, and the column is filled with solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 冲净瓶壁柱壁，放液、加沙、加满溶剂。

shots.scene: 用强极性溶剂溶样上柱，得到很宽的色带，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sample loaded in a strongly polar solvent producing a very thick band, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用更极性的溶剂上样，谱带会很厚。

shots.scene: 宽色带和窄色带对比
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: a thick smeared band and a thin sharp band. No people.
shots.narration: 分离效果就差了。

shots.scene: 备好一大瓶溶剂和一大架试管
shots.prompt_en: A large bottle of solvent and a big rack of empty test tubes sit next to the column in a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 开跑前，备足溶剂和一大架试管。

shots.scene: 钟表图标，咖啡杯被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and a coffee break icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上样后马上开跑，中途别休息。

shots.scene: 试管接在柱下，加压，打开活塞
shots.prompt_en: A test tube is placed under the column, pressure is applied and the stopcock opened.
shots.narration: 柱下放试管，加压，开活塞。

shots.scene: 慢滴、水柱、适中三种流速图标，中间打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of flow: a slow drip, a gushing stream, and a steady fast flow in the middle with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 调压力：不是慢滴，也别成水柱。

shots.scene: 小研一支接一支换试管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the outlet from one test tube to the next along the rack.
shots.narration: 连续换管收集，别让试管溢出。

shots.scene: 液面下降，滴管补加溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The solvent level in the column drops and more solvent is added from the top.
shots.narration: 盯住柱内液面，勤补溶剂。

shots.scene: 试管架里部分试管有颜色
shots.prompt_en: A rack of fractions where a few tubes are tinted blue. No people.
shots.narration: 有颜色的化合物，一眼就能看到。

shots.scene: 一块板上点了五六个点
shots.prompt_en: A plate with five or six spots in a row along the start line. No people.
shots.narration: 更可靠的是TLC，一板点五六个馏分。

shots.scene: 点样管在溶剂里清洗
shots.prompt_en: A capillary spotter is dipped in clean solvent between spots. No people.
shots.narration: 换馏分时，把点样管洗干净。

shots.scene: 展开缸里换了一种展开剂
shots.prompt_en: A plate develops in a jar holding a different solvent mix. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂选能拉开斑点的，不必和柱子一样。

shots.scene: 四块板：前后两组斑点之间有空白
shots.prompt_en: Four plates in a row: one group of spots, a few blank lanes, then a second group. No people.
shots.narration: 理想结果：一管一个化合物，中间有空管。

shots.scene: 两组斑点重叠
shots.prompt_en: Plates where two groups of spots overlap in the same lanes. No people.
shots.narration: 馏分重叠，说明没分开。

shots.scene: 斑点全挤在几管里，旁边小柱子和极性图标
shots.prompt_en: Spots packed into only a few lanes, next to icons of a small column and a high polarity gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 全挤在几管：柱太小或溶剂太极性。

shots.scene: 斑点拖得很长，旁边高柱子和大量溶剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Spots smeared across many lanes, next to icons of a tall column and a big loading volume. No people.
shots.narration: 拖得很长：柱太高或上样溶剂太多。

shots.scene: 同一化合物的试管倒进圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Fractions with the same single spot are poured through a funnel into a round-bottom flask on a cork ring.
shots.narration: 同一纯品的馏分，合并到圆底烧瓶。

shots.scene: 混合馏分的试管放到一边
shots.prompt_en: Tubes with mixed spots are set aside in a separate small rack. No people.
shots.narration: 混合馏分留着，以后再纯化。

shots.scene: 试管用少量溶剂荡洗并入，烧瓶半满
shots.prompt_en: Each tube is rinsed with a little clean solvent into the flask, which is filled only to half. No people.
shots.narration: 荡洗试管并入，烧瓶装不过一半。

shots.scene: 烧瓶上旋转蒸发仪
shots.prompt_en: The round-bottom flask spins on a rotary evaporator. No people.
shots.narration: 最后旋蒸除去溶剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣护住一架试管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot guards a rack of test tubes with both arms.
shots.narration: 拿到产品之前，一管都不要倒掉。

shots.scene: 柱中加满乙醇，加压把硅胶吹干
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood the used column is filled with solvent and air pressure pushes it through until the bed looks dry. No people.
shots.narration: 确认无产物后，加乙醇用气推干硅胶。

shots.scene: 干燥的硅胶倒进废物容器
shots.prompt_en: Dry free-flowing white powder is poured from the column into a waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 干了好倒，倒进指定废物容器。

shots.scene: 铁架台上夹着一支细长滴管
shots.prompt_en: A long glass pipette clamped upright on a ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 样品少，用滴管做个微量柱。

shots.scene: 滴管分层示意：棉花、吸附剂、沙、样品、沙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the pipette column with layers from bottom: cotton, white adsorbent, sand, colored sample powder, sand. No people.
shots.narration: 塞棉花，干装吸附剂，加沙、样品、再加沙。

shots.scene: 另一支滴管从顶部加溶剂，下面接小瓶
shots.prompt_en: Another dropper adds solvent to the top of the pipette column while a small vial collects below.
shots.narration: 下面接瓶，另一支滴管从上加溶剂。

shots.scene: 黄色谱带下移，液面始终在顶上
shots.prompt_en: A yellow band moves down the pipette while the liquid stays above the bed. No people.
shots.narration: 加到化合物出柱，同样不能跑干。

shots.scene: 小研在书桌前读空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank lab manual at a desk.
shots.narration: 看演示只是预习，代替不了讲义。

shots.scene: 书本和戴手套的手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a book and a gloved hand joined by a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和操作都要懂。

shots.scene: 老李检查玻璃柱，对着灯看有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a glass column up to the light and checks it for cracks.
shots.narration: 加压前，检查玻璃柱有无裂纹。

shots.scene: 压力调节阀拧到低位，旁边柱子夹牢
shots.prompt_en: A gas regulator knob turned to a low setting; the column is firmly clamped in two places. No people.
shots.narration: 压力用低档，柱子夹牢，按本室规程。

shots.scene: 接头被卡死、柱子胀裂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pressure adapter jammed tight on a column with crack lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接头别卡死，压力过高会胀裂柱子。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，通风柜门拉低挡在前面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears safety goggles and works behind the lowered fume hood sash.
shots.narration: 戴好护目镜，柜门放低当挡板。

shots.section_title: 台面溶剂少放、远离火源
shots.scene: 通风柜里只放一瓶溶剂，大桶在溶剂柜里
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood only one solvent bottle stands by the column; large containers are stored in a separate flammables cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 台面只放够用的溶剂，大桶放回专柜。
overlay: 台面溶剂少放、远离火源

shots.section_title: 台面溶剂少放、远离火源
shots.scene: 电热板、插线板靠近溶剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot plate and a power strip right next to an open solvent bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一架敞口馏分，远离热源和电火花。

shots.section_title: 台面溶剂少放、远离火源
shots.scene: 试管架用盖板盖上
shots.prompt_en: The rack of fractions is covered with a lid sheet to reduce vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 馏分及时合并旋蒸，别敞口久放。

shots.scene: 旋蒸烧瓶用卡夹固定
shots.prompt_en: A plastic clip secures the round-bottom flask to the rotary evaporator joint. No people.
shots.narration: 旋蒸烧瓶用卡夹夹牢，玻璃先查裂纹。

shots.scene: 停止旋转、打开放气阀，再取烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the rotation, opens the vent valve, then removes the flask.
shots.narration: 取瓶前先停转、放气，再卸下。

shots.scene: 带真空硬拔烧瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand yanking a flask off while the gauge still shows vacuum, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带着真空硬拔，烧瓶会掉进水浴。

shots.scene: 废硅胶倒进有空白标签的固废桶
shots.prompt_en: Used dry powder is poured into a lidded solid waste drum with a blank label inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 废硅胶沾有机物，按危险废物收集。

shots.scene: 废硅胶倒进普通垃圾桶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of white powder dumped into an ordinary trash bin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能扔进普通垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 在固废桶空白标签上书写
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand writes on the blank label of the waste drum with lines only.
shots.narration: 写清内容，盖好桶盖，交学校收集。

shots.scene: 一瓶溶剂打翻在通风柜台面
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle tips over on the fume hood work surface and liquid spreads. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂打翻了，先关掉附近热源电源。

shots.scene: 小研用吸附棉吸收洒漏液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, lays absorbent pads over the spill.
shots.narration: 用吸附棉吸收，保持通风。

shots.scene: 用过的吸附棉放进密封袋
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent pads are sealed in a bag and placed in the solid waste drum.
shots.narration: 用过的吸附棉装袋，按危废处理。

shots.scene: 洒漏量大，小研向王老师报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports a large spill to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 量大就撤离，报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现TLC板和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a small plate and a balance.
shots.narration: TLC选体系，Rf约0.3，算好硅胶量。

shots.scene: 柱子里棉花、沙、硅胶分层图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a column with cotton, sand and a smooth white bed. No people.
shots.narration: 湿法装柱无气泡，液面不能跑干。

shots.scene: 滴管上样与干粉上样两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dropper loading liquid and a flask pouring dry powder onto a column. No people.
shots.narration: 溶得动湿法上样，溶不动干法上样。

shots.scene: 试管架和TLC板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a test tube rack and a row of plates. No people.
shots.narration: 加压跑柱，TLC监测，合并旋蒸。

shots.scene: 护目镜、通风柜、废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, a fume hood and a waste drum in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 加压防爆裂，溶剂少放，废物分类。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一支装纯品的试管挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a test tube of pure product and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 分得清，做得稳，下次见！
